title: Delta Lake table fundamentals
summary: Delta adds transaction-log semantics around Parquet data to support reliable table operations.

blocks.text: Delta adds transaction-log semantics around Parquet data to support reliable table operations.

items: The transaction log records committed table versions and metadata.
ACID semantics help coordinate concurrent readers/writers.
Table optimization and retention operations must respect time-travel/recovery requirements.
